rationale: The agent cancelled order #W3361211 without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user’s goal was to change the luggage set to a coat, with a fallback to return the item if exchange wasn’t possible, and only cancel the entire order if there were issues. The agent did not attempt the change or a return, nor did it communicate any constraints before proceeding to cancellation. While some authentication-related tool calls are listed (find user, get details, get orders), the decisive failure is executing a cancellation without explicit user confirmation. Additionally, the agent provided refund amount and payment details without showing tool evidence in the conversation; even if accurate, the lack of confirmation before a write action is sufficient to fail under the policy.
